artists.strBiography: Mika Singh, AKA Amrik Singh, born August 18, 1967, is a bhangra/rap singer. He is the brother of Daler Mehndi. Mika, the youngest of the six Mehndi brothers, left school at the age of eight and began to focus on singing, he says. From a long journey as a kirtan singer to a pop star, he looks life as an everyday struggle to achieve the goal.  He was involved in a kissing controversy with item girl Rakhi Sawant.  Was a contestant on Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa 2007  His website is at http://www.mikasingh.in/
